subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “After a heavy rain, the small stream near school was full of water.”?
options: During art class, the teacher showed students how to fold paper cranes.
During an English test, students could use paper dictionaries, but not phones.
Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.
During lunch break, Ms. Reed made her first snowman.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「During art class, the teacher showed students how to fold paper cranes.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「During an English test, students could use paper dictionaries, but not phones.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「During lunch break, Ms. Reed made her first snowman.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.」，答案為「Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Some students made paper boats and raced them during lunch break.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
